title: Dog on Bicycle
description: A tan dog with white markings sits upright on a bicycle, its front paws resting on the handlebars as it looks to the left. The setting is a plain wall with soft light and some orange paint marks, and the colors are warm browns, white, silver, and red.
prompt: A realistic painting of a tan dog with white chest and markings sitting upright on a bicycle with its front paws placed on the chrome handlebars looking attentively to the left, the dog has brown ears and dark eyes, the bicycle has brown grips and red ends, plain background wall with soft light and a few orange paint marks, warm colors and detailed fur texture.
